title: The Golden Lid
translation: The face of Truth is covered by a golden lid. O Pushan, remove it, so that I, devoted to truth, may see.
translation_hi: सत्य का मुख सुनहरे पात्र से ढका है। हे पूषन्, उसे हटा दो, ताकि मैं, जो सत्य धर्म वाला हूँ, उसे देख सकूँ।
science: The 'golden lid' is the dazzling disc of the sun, too bright to look at directly. Astronomers study the sun's outer layers only when that glare is blocked, as during a total eclipse or with a coronagraph.
